reviews.text: 玩不了进不进去网络错误无法连接

优化堪忧，b测和demo预热都参加了，还试着和一些朋友冲了榜，但讲真比较失望，测试一直出行各种恶性bug和局内非网络因素卡顿，这次ea更是途中操作一直卡一下开局进游戏就出几次故障。虽然相比一代内容和创意都不错，但即使以ea角度来着操作、画面和优化这些都很差，更别说和同类游戏比。 而且一代中途b站代理跑路后就一直比较烂，就剩点营销了也做的很差，联机社群和游戏反馈渠道都差，这次二代更是没有服务器导致不开加速得“看运气”来指望稳定，而自己开了别人没开或者反之也会影响，本来就没有局内语音和更多自定义设置余地导致局内沟通不畅，现在更是雪上加霜，对游戏未来国内社群报悲观态度。 开发者说ea大概持续一年左右，就目前表现来说表现很差，个人因为优化问题选择退款，创意很喜欢，但联机体验很差并且各种优化因素导致不能有良好体验就不值得入手了
要不是玩过1代，我真想喊出：“日尼玛，退钱！！！！！！”

《一起开火车2：汽笛重鸣》延续了1代的「合作建轨」玩法，并在原有基础上添加了一些新内容： [h1]更丰富的生物群落[/h1] 在前作中，玩家已经习惯了程序生成的地图和随机的障碍物，而《一起开火车2》进一步扩展了这一系统。游戏引入了更多生物群落和地形，如沼泽，蜘蛛巢穴和峡谷，玩法上增加了额外的难度和变数。玩家不仅要考虑如何建轨，还要考虑避开地鼠突然在图里制造的地洞障碍，在图中扔出的炸药，或是潜在突然翻涌而上的沙虫等等。 [h1]强化的Roguelite属性[/h1] 与前作相比，我们现在可以解锁更多新角色和火车零部件。关卡设计采用分支树的形式，我们可以看到每关的奖励与难度等等，另外很重要的就是对于我们火车的自定义了，我们得根据自己的团队策略灵活配置火车，比如在商店购买加速引擎还是扩展资源车厢等零件，或是连接新的车厢。不仅要“快速铺轨”，还需要“高效铺轨”，完成每关的任务，或是提前接下悬赏，把每个螺栓用在刀刃上。 另外，咱们的人物也不是一成不变，通过解锁卡片你能获得一些强劲加成，如砍树，挖矿更快，或是让斧头可以挖矿等更通用化的操作。作为Roguelite的体现，一旦车毁我们就得重新开始，其中会保留一部分螺栓，我们可以用以解锁新的角色卡或是新的不同功能的火车头等等。 [h1]关卡编辑器和联机人数的扩充[/h1] 此次，《一起开火车2》还新增了两个花活 - 「地形指挥官模式」和「4V4对抗模式」。「地形指挥官模式」听着名字高大上，实际就是一个关卡编辑器，玩家可以自由设计和构建理想中的铁轨，并将其分享给全球的玩家社区。 而「4V4对抗模式」实际就是前作「2V2对抗模式」的升级版，为竞争心强的玩家提供了展示技巧的舞台，在这个最多可支持8人的模式中，我们不仅要合作铺设轨道，还需要时刻干扰对手的进度。 [h1]你真的需要一个朋友！[/h1] 游戏内置的电脑AI队友可以协助进行「砍树」，「挖矿」，「浇水降温」，「铺轨」等操作，前提是你操作好，不过电脑终归是电脑，它有时候也会做出一些迷惑性行为，或是把你堵在车轨后面，或是铺设的轨道有点偏。另外也游戏提供了线上大厅，你可以加入陌生人的房间。 虽然看似没有朋友你也能游玩，但我还是强烈建议你去找个游戏搭子，毕竟熟人好协作，因为游戏中看似简单的任务，往往在紧张的时刻演变成一场充满混乱的局面，忘了浇水降温，路被堵死过不去铺路导致翻车。只和电脑一起难免手忙脚乱，还是有些孤单，还是得合作整活搞怪才有意思。 [h1]结语[/h1] 虽然游戏时间不长，但笔者的确和朋友度过了一段高压但欢快的时光，每一次过关都让人倍感自豪，随着游戏的进行，关卡难度愈发升高，更复杂更古怪的地形让人惊喜，资源短缺，手忙脚乱的高压也被朋友间的互动所纾解，任你整活，做好“微操”，别玩脱了就行！ [quote] 执笔勾墨色，挥毫著文章；阳春布德泽，璞玉生光辉 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44174077/]吟遊诗人的手札[/url]，书游戏特色，写游戏魅力 [/quote]

Good concept, but terrible execution with the zoom level I was excited to play Unrailed! 2 after enjoying the first game, but the zoom level is so far out that it ruins the experience. It feels like you're watching the action from a drone miles away, and you lose all the charm and connection with the characters and the train. Worse, there's no option to adjust it in the settings. This might not bother everyone, but for me, it made the game feel impersonal and hard to enjoy. Games like this thrive on chaos and interaction, but when you're struggling to see the details, it just becomes frustrating. A simple zoom adjustment option would make a world of difference. Until then, it's a no from me. Rating: ★★☆☆☆

[h1]本评价在EA时期由好评转为差评，并将延续[/h1] [hr][/hr] [h3]工作室的日常 be like：[/h3] 修复bug→动了屎山代码 ↑ ↓ 需要更新←出现新的bug [hr][/hr] ● 万米/十几万米存档，换地图卡加载搞人心态，存档近乎报费； ● 进个野房，开不开加速器都进不去。咋的里面是有不干净的东西触发保护了？ ● 进好友房，玩家和玩家之间还有看不见的屏障——A先进B后进，可以进；B先进A再进，A就进不去了，就你这还配叫多人游戏？让人家还玩个屁。 ● 你爹爹们等了快三年了，缺的第五个车头谁给我补啊，没那个车你留个鸡毛空呢； ● 说是肉鸽，全是伪随机，没肉鸽那种爽点的命，得了肉鸽的病：数值叠加有衰减，不衰减就有上限，玩nm； ● 还是那句话，351后再无火车2，一天天不知道在削些什么东西，我奇了怪了； ● 进路人对战模式房结果人满了强制卡进旁观，然后进入死循环：人满了不能加入游戏→加入游戏才能打开菜单→退不出去→人满了不能加入游戏→加入游戏才能打开菜单→退不出去→人满了不能加入游戏→ ...... →最后强制关闭游戏才能退出去。你们到底有没有吃过自己拉的屎？ ● 车厢平衡稀烂，以刹车为代表的车厢现在纯属弟中弟。几个特殊车厢就前三个能用的，后面三个狗都不用，传送门还不如任务车厢，人家好好的在那里待着，哪个没脑子想出来要给他替换了的? ● 配件平衡稀烂，永远有弟弟配件，幽灵和自动掉落看都看不上的，做进游戏里干嘛? ● 插卡平衡稀烂，钩爪真王朝了好吧，我chovy，你做投掷给我特么做好了呀； ● 钩爪总是钩车厢里的铁是什么玩意儿，宣传片里都有这个问题，你们自己笑了没； ● 插卡系统能不能做简单点：进房间前让玩家手动选择工种，智能ban卡，系统自动匹配工种拿卡很难吗？遇到长途高速玩具车，进去先拿半小时的卡，一撞车全白拿，能蚌住的都是神人了； ● 没自己设计观念的底线，不知道哪个司马玩意儿提议给玩具车头也加榜的，你们还真能听进去。他们爱浪费时间卷死局就自嗨去呗，凭什么带上所有人去跑这个弱智榜单，跑几十万米比的是谁闲出屁，比的是谁命长？ ● 你邱培林姐的简中翻译有一手的，前部吸取能给你翻译成下一节车厢，游戏是不玩的，吃培林榨菜是吃到脑子发昏的。 ● 如今的榜单含金量堪比路边一条，排列组合出几十上百个榜一，比你游戏日活都多； ● 坑逼人机，优化几百遍都没优化明白，不是进入bug死循环开始挂机就是跑哪个犄角旮旯找不到路径； ● 一代做的很成熟的东西，诶你猜怎么着？就是不用，就是要标新立异，就是要特立独行——表情系统和标点方式做的特么和屎一样，这么爱玩你那个破逼轮盘呢，让手柄玩家玩玩轮盘就得了，键盘玩家0人爱用好吗？打开轮盘还得找数字去按才能发出来，一代打开轮盘直接按方向键就能发出来怎么就很正常呢，二代就是头上长角和别人不一样，一想到玩着玩着还得拿起鼠标给机器人标个点我就想笑。 ● 自作聪明，地图编辑工具也他妈和傻逼一样用轮盘当菜单，反人类的东西，你们他妈是人啊，做个图翻轮盘翻半天，还有bug，转半天收不回来，界面左上角几个图标也没文字说明，谁知道你这几个快捷键是什么意思，抄别人设计软件搞个侧边栏很难吗，我请问呢？ ● 疯狂迷宫这图里按M键透视地块的功能你他妈留着自己用吧，我给黑卡绑的这个键，差点没被你闪瞎 ● 傻逼游戏吃鼠标，就算窗口模式也吃鼠标，那我考考你，设置菜单里的窗口和全屏的区别是什么？ ● 多人游戏，玩家要的是联机体验，延迟低，加载快才是硬道理。我寻思着你游戏没发售前的beta版本和demo版本，我们就算不开加速器也没有明显延迟，怎么一发售就开始有这些问题了？合着演我们老玩家呢是吧。 ● 好吧，其实0个人会在意火车进站以后帧率是144帧还是1440帧，我每次看见右上角帧率飙到4位数的时候我都在想，一个休闲游戏而已，搁这儿和隔壁CS2、DOTA2竞技类游戏拼流畅呢。优化到一百帧出头差不多得了，你有这功夫不如解锁一下前作那个万年不变的60帧锁帧。

700小时测评。我将一直给差评，除非哪次更新恢复了以前的好玩。每次更新都在削弱，玩家玩得并不能像刚开始的版本那么爽了。节奏越来越慢，没有玩下去的动力。我们需要更多元化，更多选择。官方的平衡性更新只适合部分玩家，更多玩家需要快节奏的爽玩。翻译成英文 I will keep giving bad reviews unless an update restores the fun it used to have. Every update is about weakening things, and players can't have as much fun as they did in the initial version. The pace is getting slower and slower, and there's no motivation to keep playing. We need more diversity and more options. The official balance updates only cater to some players; more players need fast-paced, enjoyable gameplay.

I love this game, but it just isn't finished yet. It's so easy to run into a game breaking bug, like a tool being destroyed but never re-spawned, my mouse refusing to move to the right half of the screen, or the game simply crashing with no way to reload the save. If these bugs occur during a run, I have to watch my train slowly run into a dead end with no way to stop it. If I encountered bugs like these in any other game, I'd just quit playing; but this game is really well designed and fun to play. I love how the game offers the player the ability to customize their character and train how they like. It's hard to find a game the offers freedom without being restrictive. The people I've co-oped this game with have all have different preferences and ideas than me, and I love when a game can have that effect. I just wish it were less buggy.

[h1] 虽然它本身就是个有朋友才好玩的游戏，但单人游玩的难度实在过于离谱 [/h1] 人数达到4人只要分工明确不互相挤基本上全程平推，但是人数减少却没有做相应的难度调整，到了两个人的时候容错已经基本消失了，要是一个人和bot玩是一点容错都没有。 bot蠢过头了，也就是说不与真人一起玩是绝对玩不了的。 不知道是什么样的寻路机制，能导致我都开好道了这bot还会铺一条远路出来。 本身游戏节奏非常紧张，后期也完全没有足够的时间和容错对bot下达指令。 特别是boos关，非常多的东西需要处理，但凡下指令慢了一点就直接GG。 单人模式还是建议在下指令的时候加一个子弹时间、或者干脆加一个暂停，甚至把两个步骤单一的指令合在一起我都觉得没什么问题。

Unrailed 2 has the same basic gameplay as Unrailed: you and your crew hurry to gather resources to build a train track and get to a station before you reach the end of the line and crash. You have to deal with obstacles in the environment and upgrade your train at stations you find along the way. However, almost every system in the game has been expanded. There are more biomes, more train cars, more challenges, and more ways to upgrade. You can customize your cars by leveling them and by giving them extra add-ons, and you can upgrade your character with special active and passive abilities. Each station gives you the ability to buy or customize different parts of your train, and you have some choice over the difficulty in each level. Each biome also ends with a boss fight, which adds a unique challenge and grants special rewards. Coming from the first game, I was very overwhelmed the first time I tried this one. There are a lot of different systems to learn and some abilities got reworked. Even with the tutorial, it was a lot to get used to. However, now that I've gotten used to the game, I think I like it even more than the first one. The hectic, co-op gameplay has the same energy, but the challenges are more dynamic. I love all the new biomes, even though some of them are very challenging, and the boss fights are fun and make finishing a biome more exciting. The different upgrades for your train are a lot of fun as well, and I've had a lot of fun experimenting with how to combine upgrades to give your train special abilities. I would sum up Unrailed 2 as "basically the same but better." Building the track, progressing through the levels, and strategizing with your friends feels the same, but with a lot more variety and challenge. If you loved the first game, you'll love the second just as much, and if you got tired of the first one, the sequel may hold your attention a little longer. 10/10

Unrailed 2: Back on Track é um caótico jogo co-op de construção de trilhos. O jogo conta com mundos com diversos biomas e chefes. Neles é necessário o jogador ser veloz para conseguir minerar ferro e madeira para construir trilhos enquanto o trem anda, além do trem pegar fogo e inimigos pelo caminho atrapalharem a mineração. O jogador pode melhorar o personagem e a locomotiva para conseguir um melhor desempenho. O jogo é comercializado como co-op, mas pode ser jogado em modo solo. A diferença é que este jogo é muito mais atrativo e divertido se for jogado com outra pessoa, seja com um amigo ou co-op em um servidor público. Para mim, Unrailed 2: Back on Track é um ótimo jogo para relaxar a mente enquanto se joga sozinho, pois com o tempo o jogo fica cansativo e sem a diversão que ele pode gerar em um co-op. Unrailed 2: Back on Track é um excelente jogo para jogar com amigos e um ótimo jogo para descansar a mente caso jogue sozinho. O jogo é perfeito, o visual voxel e a trilha marcante, a jogabilidade, e as diversas fases e biomas que são gerados no jogo tornam esse jogo único.
